Q: How do you evaluate chunk overlap without counting duplicate evidence as extra recall?
spoken: Define relevance at the appropriate source or passage identity, deduplicate overlapping hits under that evaluation contract and inspect answer-support coverage. Overlap can preserve context but increases storage, repeated tokens and correlated results. Evaluate boundary cases such as headings, exceptions and table rows instead of choosing chunk size solely by a convenient token number.
